$comment: X-25 MACHINE-READABLE REASON-CODE REGISTRY — the single source of truth, owned by the federation design authority under umbrella §13.4 (registry lifecycle: additive, deprecate-never-delete, quarterly + expedited security path). The reference linters LOAD their recognized-set tables from this file (evidence_lint NDE_REASON_EVENT, lint_cli RELAY_B2_*), so registering a code is a REGISTRY ACTION here — not a schema, CDDL or lint-code change, and NOT an evidence-version bump (umbrella §9.3). The wire value space is lexically bounded by the schemas (^(x-)?[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,62}$; x- = private use, never registered). An UNREGISTERED well-formed code is accepted structurally, preserved verbatim and treated as a generic non-delivery (LINT-NDE-W1; the I-D, IANA Considerations). allowed_events: null = the reason-to-event binding is not yet registered (finding X-30) — a producer SHOULD NOT emit it until bound.

envelope-hash-mismatch.en_319_522: no-equivalent (SM-MLS transport-commitment coherence, DR-02; exported as SubmissionRejection): the submitted octets do not hash to the supplied envelope_hash, so RDP(out) refuses to attest them

keypackage-replay.en_319_522: no-equivalent (MLS KeyPackage single-use rule; exported as SubmissionRejection / ContentConsignmentFailure per stage)

keypackage-target-duplicate.en_319_522: no-equivalent (one device named twice in a reservation's targets — two packages for one device and none for another is the failure this catches (DR-08); exported as SubmissionRejection)

keypackage-target-unavailable.en_319_522: no-equivalent (a SELECTED device has no current KeyPackage for the group's suite — the reservation is refused whole rather than served partially (DR-08); exported as SubmissionRejection)

keypackage-target-unrequested.en_319_522: no-equivalent (the pool offered a package for a device that was NOT selected — accepting it would add a device the scope resolution excluded (DR-08); exported as SubmissionRejection)

malformed-envelope.en_319_522: SubmissionRejection — technical (A.2) / RelayFailure at the relay stage (X-28)

payload-hash-mismatch.en_319_522: no-equivalent (SM-MLS integrity re-verification; exported as ContentConsignmentFailure)

policy-block.en_319_522: SubmissionRejection — policy non-acceptance (A.2) / RelayFailure at the relay stage (X-28)

recipient-unreachable.en_319_522: ContentConsignmentFailure — recipient ERDS unreachable (EN 319 522-1 clause 6, D.2)

uid-merged.en_319_522: recipient status prevents delivery (redirect carried in redirect_uid) — SubmissionRejection / RelayFailure / ContentConsignmentFailure per stage

uid-retired.en_319_522: recipient status prevents delivery — SubmissionRejection / RelayFailure / ContentConsignmentFailure per stage

unknown-uid.en_319_522: SubmissionRejection — unknown recipient (A.2) / RelayFailure at the relay stage (X-28)

$comment_x30: X-30: every ACTIVE nde_reason MUST carry the complete reason x stage x event x external-mapping row - stages (stage -> EN 319 522-1 clause 6 event), allowed_events (== the stage events, kept for the LINT-NDE-07 table), en_319_522 (the EN 319 522-2 semantic mapping, or an explicit no-equivalent with the exported translation). lint_cli REFUSES to load an incomplete registration - a complete mapping is a PREREQUISITE for adding a value. Stages: intake | relay | consignment | expiry | handover.

group_establishment_reasons.$comment: R3-08: outcomes of GROUP ESTABLISHMENT, which happens BEFORE any submission. These are not NDE reasons: an NDE reports the fate of a message, and here there is no message — no message_id, no SE, no chain. `suite-below-published-floor` was registered as the intake event A.2-SubmissionRejection, which cannot be issued for a declined Welcome. R5-04/R5-V2: the outcome travels as `POST /welcome/{welcome_id}/refusal` on the Delivery Service, authenticated by the refusing device's KeyPackage credential and bound to the Welcome it declines. R4-U4 routed it over MLS on the reasoning that the device was 'already an invited member' — INVITED IS NOT JOINED: sending an authenticated message in that group means running the key schedule under the very suite being refused, which is the thing the refusal exists to avoid. The standalone `GroupEstablishmentRefusal-v1` object stays WITHDRAWN: this outcome must ARRIVE, not be retained.

suite-below-published-floor.en_319_522: no-equivalent (pre-submission group establishment; EN 319 522 events describe the fate of a MESSAGE and none exists at this point)
suite-below-published-floor.detail: the selected cipher suite is below the mandatory mls-suite-floor/v1 or below a device's published raise; the invited member declines the Welcome and the group is not formed (DR-15/R2-M5)

group-info-mismatch.en_319_522: no-equivalent (pre-submission group establishment; no message exists yet)
group-info-mismatch.detail: R10-05: the GroupInfo carried by the decrypted Welcome does not match the invitation's group_info_commitment, which the invited device reads from its WelcomeQueue item; the device declines and the group is not formed with it. The Delivery Service cannot verify the claim — the Welcome is encrypted to the device — and records the authenticated refusal for the creator. Not a cipher-suite refusal, and it carries no floor.

$comment_submission: R5-01: the typed reasons RDP(out) may return from POST /submissions, BEFORE any evidence exists. The wallet-RDP contract already promised 'the registry reasons (no-matching-scope, ...)' while no registry section held them, so 'typed' meant 'a string the mock happened to use'. Registered here and asserted against the code by tests/test_intake_obligations.py, so a new rejection reason cannot be invented silently at a surface a client has to switch on.

expiry-not-after-sent.detail: X-22 (R10-08): expires_at is not strictly later than sent_at — a reversed or zero TTL. Refused at intake, before any ledger or remote effect.

expiry-beyond-max-ttl.detail: X-22 (R10-08): the TTL (expires_at − sent_at) exceeds the recipient's declared maximum, BW-ORG.max_ttl (absent = the profile default P30D). Refused at intake.

sent-at-in-future.detail: X-22 (R10-08): sent_at lies more than the 5-minute propagation bound ahead of the accepting RDP's own clock. Refused at intake.

membership_register_reasons.$comment: Batch A / A2: why a MembershipRecord cannot answer an as-of admission question. These are not submission rejections — no message is involved — so they get their own block rather than being swept into the intake one because they happen to live in the same module. Raised by lint_cli.validate_status_history: the closed `MembershipRecord` Schema constrains the shape of each history entry and cannot express the relations BETWEEN entries, which is what all of these are about.

confirmation_rejection_reasons.$comment: R11-02/R11-03: the typed refusals of wallet-RDP POST /confirmations (422, and 409 for confirmation-conflict). The contract promised 'a typed reason' and no public artefact listed them, so a client could not switch on them — invariant 8. Stage `confirmation`: raised before anything is stored or sealed.
